canDoYue: 你識問金手鏈報價，同埋星期五用擦亮劑保養耳環。
canDoEn: Ask the price of a gold bracelet and whether a polish will keep the earrings bright.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Could you quote a fair price for this gold bracelet before we leave the shop at noon?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以畀呢條金手鏈一個公道價，我哋中午離開舖頭之前？
dialogue.say: Could you quote a fair price for this gold bracelet before we leave the shop at noon?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: I can quote three thousand for the gold bracelet, and the clasp is included in that price.
dialogue.glossYue: 金手鏈我可以報三千蚊，個扣包咗喺價錢入面。
dialogue.say: I can quote three thousand for the gold bracelet, and the clasp is included in that price.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Would a soft cloth polish keep these gold earrings bright if I wear them every Friday night?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我每個星期五晚上戴金耳環，軟布擦亮劑可唔可以保持光亮？
dialogue.say: Would a soft cloth polish keep these gold earrings bright if I wear them every Friday night?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: A soft cloth polish will keep the earrings bright, and I can do it here on Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 軟布擦亮劑可以保持耳環光亮，我星期五可以喺度做。
dialogue.say: A soft cloth polish will keep the earrings bright, and I can do it here on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Is the quote for both earrings lower if I take the pair home with me this Friday?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我星期五帶兩隻耳環返去，報價會唔會低啲？
dialogue.say: Is the quote for both earrings lower if I take the pair home with me this Friday?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The quote for both earrings is two thousand dollars, and Friday noon is fine for collection here.
dialogue.glossYue: 兩隻耳環報價二千蚊，星期五中午可以喺度取。
dialogue.say: The quote for both earrings is two thousand dollars, and Friday noon is fine for collection here.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Please set that paper aside, and I will decide on the gold bracelet after the polish later.
dialogue.glossYue: 請先放低張紙，我遲啲擦完再決定金手鏈。
dialogue.say: Please set that paper aside, and I will decide on the gold bracelet after the polish later.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: I will hold that paper until noon, and a clean cloth can wait here beside the polish.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會留住張紙到中午，乾淨布可以放喺擦亮劑旁邊。
dialogue.say: I will hold that paper until noon, and a clean cloth can wait here beside the polish.
